{{Top|leg}}
An '''energy-wave detector''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The [[Multi-environment Space Boat]] [[Explorer (space boat)|''Explorer'']] was equipped with energy-wave detectors for use in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and under the [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>

==Appearances==
*''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''
